data.long_meaning: From the Germanic elements hari, meaning army or warrior, and ric, meaning power or ruler. This name was originally used for a nobleman or a member of the nobility. In Christian contexts, it may symbolize spiritual power and leadership. The name Heringer carries the meaning “Aristocrat, ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Heringer usually hope their child will grow to embody aristocrat, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
